_comment: Who a finished tutorial is FOR. scripts/publish-videos.mjs writes this into storage/tutorials/manifest.json and the app (src/services/tutorial-video.service.js) shows/streams it only to that audience (an administrator sees all; a logged-in user also sees 'public'). Allowed: public | user | partner | employee | admin. A scenario missing here is published as 'admin' (the most restrictive) and the publish script warns - nothing leaks by forgetting to list it. Order of the lines = order on the page. Names are scenario folder names WITHOUT the -mobilni suffix.
